g.text: Linear confined-aquifer drawdowns from two wells add at an observation point

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Illustrative confined steady superposition of logarithmic reference solutions; R=200 m for each reference head change. Common regional boundary
corrections are not solved. Profiles cap radius at1 m near wells to avoid singularity. Linear head equation/constant T permit superposition; unconfined
saturated-thickness changes generally prevent direct addition of water-table drawdowns.
